title: Warning Signature Remap Manifest
description: Emitted when a warning producer changes its signature_fields. Consumed by the central re-key tool to migrate sidecar dismissals/acknowledgements.

remap_rule.description: Human-readable description of the rule that derived the new signature from the old, e.g. 'drop_offset_field' or 'add_field_path'.

explicit_remap.description: Explicit map of old signature string -> new signature string for every dismissal currently observed in sidecars.
